lines.text: وان كان راجعاً ذهبت قوته كلها وايضاً ابو محامد غزنوی در کتاب كفاية التعليم گوید که کوکب
lines.en: And if it is retrograde, all its strength is gone. And also Abu Mahamid Ghaznavi says in the book Kifayat al-Ta'lim that a planet

lines.text: در حال رجعت بمنزله بیماری گرفته اند مضطرب با بحران چنانکه بیماری با بحران را پنج وقت است
lines.en: in the state of retrogradation is like a sick person, agitated with a crisis, just as a sickness with a crisis has five times.

lines.text: هم چنین رجعت را پنج وقت است و اول ان اوقات وقت اقامت است بجهة رجعت چون وقت
lines.en: Likewise, retrogradation has five times. And the first of those times is the time of station for the sake of retrogradation, like the time

lines.text: ابتدای بیماری نفس وقت رجعت است و وقت تزايد بیماری وقت میانه رجعت است
lines.en: of the beginning of the sickness. The essence of the time of retrogradation is the time of the increase of the sickness. The middle time of retrogradation is

lines.text: چون وقت انتهای بیماری و وقت رجعت دوم است چون وقت انحطاط بیماری و وقت
lines.en: like the time of the end of the sickness. And the time of the second retrogradation is like the time of the decline of the sickness. And the time

lines.text: اقامت از برای استقامت است چون وقت انقضای بیماری و مقابله علویین بافتاب و احتراق
lines.en: of station for the sake of direct motion is like the time of the expiration of the sickness. And the opposition of the superior planets with the sun and the combustion

lines.text: سفلی در میان رجعت بمنزله روز بحران قوی است (تنبیه) مراد از رجعت اول انستکه کوکب
lines.en: of the inferior planets in the middle of retrogradation is like the day of a strong crisis. (Note) The meaning of the first retrogradation is that the planet

lines.text: در میانه مقام اول و نقطه حضیض مرئی بوده باشد و مراد از رجعت دوم میانه حضیض و مقام
lines.en: is between the first station and the point of visible perigee. And the meaning of the second retrogradation is between the perigee and the second station.

lines.text: ثانی بوده باشد و زردشت حکیم گوید که رجوع الكواكب العلوية الاول من حين رجعة
lines.en: And Zoroaster the sage says that the first retrogradation of the superior planets is from the time of the retrogradation

lines.text: الكواكب الى ان يبلغ نصف درجات رجوعه ورجعة الكواكب السفلية الاول من حين يرجع
lines.en: of the planets until it reaches half the degrees of its retrogradation. And the first retrogradation of the inferior planets is from the time it retrogrades

lines.text: الى ان يجاوز الشمس مشرقا فيرى في المشرق ورجوعه الثانى من وقت رؤيته في المشرق الى ان
lines.en: until it passes the sun in the east and is seen in the east. And its second retrogradation is from the time of its visibility in the east until

lines.text: يستقيم انتهى كلامه ( احکام رجعت زحل در بروج اثنی عشر ) رجعت زحل مطلقا دلالت
lines.en: it becomes direct. His speech ends. (Judgments of the retrogradation of Saturn in the twelve signs) The retrogradation of Saturn absolutely indicates

lines.text: کند بر ضعف حال پیران و مزاوغان و ارباب خاندانهای قدیم و فراخی طعام و کساد حیوانات
lines.en: the weakness of the condition of the elderly, the deceitful, and the lords of ancient families, and the abundance of food, and the stagnation of animals,

lines.text: و حرکت عساکر و انتقال مردم از اوطان و خسارت اهل فلاحت و موت عجایز و اوارگی اکراد
lines.en: and the movement of armies, and the transfer of people from their homelands, and the loss of the people of agriculture, and the death of old women, and the wandering of Kurds

lines.text: و اهل جبال ( رجعت زحل در برج حمل ) دلالت کند بر حدث و خسف و زلازل و بیماری
lines.en: and the people of the mountains. (The retrogradation of Saturn in the sign of Aries) indicates an event, and an eclipse, and earthquakes, and sickness,

lines.text: رعد و برق و صاعقه ( رجعت زحل در برج ثور ) دلالت کند بر کثرت غم و هم در ملوک و
lines.en: thunder and lightning, and thunderbolts. (The retrogradation of Saturn in the sign of Taurus) indicates the abundance of sorrow and grief among kings and

lines.text: موت یکی از عظماء دولت و کدورت قضاة و نقصان خراج و اضطراب لشکریان و فتنه
lines.en: the death of one of the great men of the state, and the turbidity of judges, and the decrease of tribute, and the agitation of soldiers, and sedition

lines.text: در میان ایشان و ظفر پادشاه و کثرت اراجیف خاصه در ناحیه جنوب و حزن اهل مناصب
lines.en: among them, and the victory of the king, and the abundance of rumors, especially in the southern region, and the sorrow of the people of positions,

lines.text: و وبا در پیران ( رجعت زحل در برج جوزا ) دلالت کند بر خشکی هوا و نقصان آبها خاصاً
lines.en: and cholera among the elderly. (The retrogradation of Saturn in the sign of Gemini) indicates the dryness of the air and the decrease of waters, especially

lines.text: در قنوات و عیون و عرض دیدن پادشاه اسباب خزائن و بیوتات و قیمت کردن بر
lines.en: in qanats and springs, and the king's inspection of the causes of treasuries and households, and the pricing for

lines.text: لشکریان و مستحقان ( رجعت زحل در برج سرطان ) دلالت کند بر مرگ مردی بزرگ
lines.en: soldiers and the deserving. (The retrogradation of Saturn in the sign of Cancer) indicates the death of a great man

lines.text: و زیاده شدن اب انهار و نقصان اب چشمها و بادها سخت و بیماری یاران و کدورت
lines.en: and the increase of the water of rivers, and the decrease of the water of springs, and strong winds, and the sickness of friends, and the turbidity

lines.text: یکی از فرماندهان بلاد سرطان ( رجعت زحل در برج اسد ) دلالت کند بر موت ظالم
lines.en: of one of the commanders of the lands of Cancer. (The retrogradation of Saturn in the sign of Leo) indicates the death of an oppressor

summary.headline: Saturn Retrogradation in the Signs
summary.text: Discussion of planetary retrogradation as a five-stage sickness, citing Abu Mahamid Ghaznavi’s Kifayat al-Ta'lim and Zoroaster’s rules for superior and inferior planets. Judgments for Saturn’s retrogradation cover general effects and predictions in Aries through Leo, including eclipses, earthquakes, drought, political unrest, deaths, and disease.
